discription: A sharp, short saw wave pluck sound with an ADSR envelope, suitable for percussive or lead synth lines.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.005, 0.05, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Saw.ar(freq) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
